stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a tank in 14 hours and pipe B can fill it in 27 hours. If both are opened together, how many hours will it take to fill the tank? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In one hour A fills $\dfrac{1}{14}$ of the tank and B fills $\dfrac{1}{27}$, so together they fill $\dfrac{1}{14} + \dfrac{1}{27} = 0.108466$ per hour. The full tank takes $\dfrac{1}{0.108466} = 9.2195$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: Add rates, never times — the combined time is always less than either pipe alone.
